## Activity

During November 2022, River Outreach recorded 54 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity level should continue to be monitored through routine site operations reporting, with any recurring issues documented for follow-up. The clinic lead has requested that camera issues be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Image quality

Image review identified 9 ungradable captures. This was an ungradable rate of 16.7% of all captures recorded at the site during November 2022. The site should continue to check image quality at the point of capture and record recurring camera issues with the service desk.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. Results should continue to be reviewed through the established process, with referable findings managed in accordance with service arrangements. The reported activity, image quality, and grading measures provide the monthly operational summary for River Outreach.
